env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^parity ok$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exec grep -q 'json\.Marshal(payload)' out/main.go
! exec grep -q 'payload\.MarshalJSON()' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
stdout '^parity ok$'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/callsite

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type User struct {
	ID    int64  `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	user := User{ID: 7, Name: "ada"}
	direct, err := user.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	payload := User{ID: 7, Name: "ada", Email: "a@x.y"}
	via, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	plain, err := json.Marshal(User{ID: 7, Name: "ada"})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(direct, plain) {
		panic("direct call diverged")
	}
	fmt.Println("parity ok")
	_ = via
}
